name: tinypivot
title: TinyPivot — Interactive Data IDE for AI Agents
description: Interactive MCP App, terminal Unicode cards, live Ghostty TUI, and native Claude plugin that turns CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, API/MCP outputs, and SQL results from any database into interactive charts, deterministic pivot tables, data grids, drill-through, and Excel exports.

tools.name: open_tinypivot
tools.description: Open the interactive TinyPivot data grid, pivot table, and chart explorer (works with {} using the built-in sample dataset).

tools.name: load_file
tools.description: Load a local CSV, TSV, JSON, or JSONL file (or SQL CLI export from any database) with 0 raw rows entering LLM context; pass chartConfig/pivotConfig to render in 1 call.

tools.name: load_data
tools.description: Load flat JSON rows already in memory (<500 rows from APIs, MCP tools, or small SQL queries) directly into TinyPivot without writing an intermediate CSV.

tools.name: configure_pivot
tools.description: Compute a deterministic pivot table via @smallwebco/tinypivot-core with zero LLM math errors.

tools.name: configure_chart
tools.description: Configure interactive charts (bar, stackedBar, line, area, pie, donut, scatter, bubble, heatmap, radar) and framed Unicode terminal cards.

tools.name: query_postgres
tools.description: (Optional Pro) Run AST-validated read-only SELECT queries against PostgreSQL (DATABASE_URL) with 0 raw rows entering LLM context.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List currently loaded datasets, row counts, and inferred column schemas.

free.truncationPolicy: Explicit UI amber banner + LLM summary warning (never silent)
includes: Core charts (bar, stackedBar, line, area, pie, donut)
Data grid (sort, filter, search, Markdown copy, CSV export)
Framed Unicode terminal cards & live Ghostty TUI
All 5 visual themes (Code, Phosphor, Nord, Thermal, Mono)

privacy.telemetry: Anonymous zero-PII pings (event, tool, rowBucket, client, tier, version, os); never collects row data, column names, SQL, or file paths; opt out via TINYPIVOT_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
